settings.title: Stasia's Formulation Skincare

ingredients.description: A lightweight, plant-derived lipid that closely mimics the skin’s natural oils. It helps keep lips soft and comfortable by reducing moisture loss and improving smoothness without feeling greasy.
ingredients.name: Squalane

ingredients.description: A nutrient-rich botanical oil containing vitamin E, sterols, and fatty acids. It helps nourish dry lips, improve softness, and support the natural moisture barrier.
ingredients.name: Argania Spinosa Kernal Oil

ingredients.description: A glossy, protective emollient that forms a flexible barrier on the lips. It helps seal in moisture, improves product wear time, and gives the formula a smooth, cushiony glide.
ingredients.name: Polyisobutene

ingredients.description: A stabilized form of jojoba oil that creates a soft, breathable protective layer. It helps condition the lips and improves the structure of the formula so it feels silky rather than oily.
ingredients.name: Hydrogenated Jojoba Oil
C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate
ingredients.description: A lightweight conditioning ingredient that improves spreadability and gives the formula a silky, non-greasy finish. It helps the product glide smoothly and layer well with other lip products.

ingredients.name: Hippophae Rhamnoides Fruit Oil (Sea Buckthorn Oil)
ingredients.description: A vibrant botanical oil rich in carotenoids, fatty acids, and antioxidants. It helps support lip nourishment and contributes to a healthy-looking appearance.

ingredients.name: Cetyl Alcohol
ingredients.description: A fatty alcohol derived from plant oils that helps stabilize the formula and create a smooth, creamy texture. It adds cushion and improves how the product feels on the lips.

ingredients.name: Tocopherol (Vitamin E)
ingredients.description: A natural antioxidant that helps protect the formula from oxidation while also helping condition the lips and support softness.

ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.description: Deeply hydrates and softens dry cuticles while absorbing quickly without leaving a greasy feel.

ingredients.name: Coco-Caprylate/Caprate
ingredients.description: Gives the oil a smooth, lightweight texture that helps it glide onto the skin and absorb easily.

ingredients.name: Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil (Argan Oil)
ingredients.description: It is rich in nourishing fatty acids that help condition cuticles and support stronger-looking nails.

ingredients.name: Vitis Vinifera Seed Oil (Grapeseed Oil)
ingredients.description: Provides lightweight moisture and antioxidants that help soften rough skin around the nails.

ingredients.name: Simmondsia Chinensis Seed Oil (Jojoba Oil)
ingredients.description: Closely resembles the skin’s natural oils, helping to deeply hydrate and repair dry, cracked cuticles.

ingredients.name: Ricinus Communis Seed Oil (Castor Oil)
ingredients.description: Adds rich conditioning and helps lock in moisture while giving nails a healthy shine.

ingredients.name: Tocopherol (Vitamin E)
ingredients.description: Acts as an antioxidant that helps protect and nourish the skin while supporting overall nail and cuticle health.

ingredients.name: Citrus Limon Peel Oil
ingredients.description: Provides a fresh citrus scent and helps give nails a brighter, cleaner appearance.

ingredients.name: Mica / Mineral Pigments
ingredients.description: Creates the pink lemonade color and soft rose-gold shimmer that adds a subtle glow when applied.
